title: Web Crawler
description: Simple web crawler with configurable output filename and crawler type selection.

outputFilename.title: ✅ Output Filename (REQUIRED)
outputFilename.description: Name of the output file (without .json extension) - This field is required

crawlerType.title: Crawler type (optional)
crawlerType.description: Select the type of crawler to use for web scraping
enumTitles: Adaptive switching between browser and raw HTTP - Fast and renders JavaScript content if present. This is the recommended option.
Headless browser (Firefox+Playwright) - Reliable, renders JavaScript content, best in avoiding blocking, but might be slow.
Raw HTTP client (Cheerio) - Fastest, but doesn't render JavaScript content.
Raw HTTP client with JavaScript (JSDOM) - Experimental, use at your own risk.
[DEPRECATED] Headless browser (Chrome+Playwright) - The crawler will use Firefox+Playwright instead.
